channel.title: DevBox Changelog
channel.description: Recent updates, new tools, and fixes on DevBox

item.title: Extension distribution, and a caching bug fixed for good
item.description:
• Added a new Extension page with a direct download link and step-by-step install instructions, linked from the sidebar and homepage.
  • Fixed a service worker bug where updated CSS/JS wouldn't reach returning visitors after a deploy -- the cache version is now bumped automatically on every push via CI, so nobody needs to clear their cache again.
  • Fixed a sidebar layout bug where the Changelog/Extension/Contact shortcut links would clip or overlap once a new one was added.

item.title: Cheatsheet downloads, social previews, tool chaining, and a browser extension
item.description:
• Added Print and Markdown download buttons to all 4 cheatsheets, with print styles that stay readable regardless of your current theme.
  • Generated a branded preview image for each of the 14 tool categories and wired the correct one into every tool page, so shared links now show a proper preview instead of a generic one.
  • Added tool chaining ("Send to →") so a tool's output can become another tool's input in one click -- wired across the JSON/data-format family (JSON Formatter, JSON Schema, JSON Path, JSON↔CSV, YAML, XML) and the encoding family (Base64, URL, JWT into JSON Formatter).
  • Added a browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Brave) with a toolbar popup for quick access to 10 common tools, plus right-click actions on any selected text -- Format as JSON, Base64 Decode, URL Decode, Decode JWT, and Hash -- that open the matching tool with your selection already filled in.

item.title: Cheatsheets, embeddable tools, and an automated test suite
item.description:
• Added a Cheatsheets section: Regex, Git, Bash & Linux, and Docker quick references, searchable and cross-linked with related tools.
  • Added an Embed Generator -- any tool or cheatsheet can now be dropped into another site or wiki via a copy-paste <iframe> snippet.
  • Added structured data (JSON-LD) to every tool and cheatsheet page for richer search engine results.
  • Added an automated regression test suite covering every real bug class this project has hit, wired into CI so it runs on every push.

item.title: SEO foundations
item.description:
• Added a sitemap.xml covering every page and a robots.txt pointing to it.
  • Verified the site behaves correctly when deployed under a subpath (e.g. a GitHub Pages project site) rather than a domain root.

item.title: PWA support restored, safely
item.description: • Brought back service-worker-backed installability ("Add to Home Screen") without reintroducing stale cached pages -- HTML is now always fetched fresh when online, with the cache used only as an offline fallback.

item.title: Cross-browser fixes
item.description:
• Fixed click-to-upload silently failing in some browsers (the hidden file input wasn't being attached to the page before being triggered).
  • Fixed the share button's style to match the rest of the site's buttons.
  • Removed an unnecessary service worker that was causing edited pages to keep showing stale content.

item.title: Stability pass
item.description:
• Fixed the Regex Tester freezing the tab on catastrophic-backtracking patterns.
  • Fixed the Diff Checker hanging on very long single lines (e.g. minified code).
  • Fixed pages breaking entirely when localStorage is blocked (private browsing, strict cookie policies).
  • Reorganized the tool sidebar into clearer categories.
